Sit at max auto range, last-hit with patience, and do not approach walls where her Hookshot (E) can knock you up into a full early combo. At Level 2 her E goes live at a 16-second cooldown and she becomes a genuine kill threat: she knocks you up, lands the delayed second Precision Protocol hit for true damage, and leaves on its bonus move speed before your second Winter's Wrath arc fills the gauge you need for Permafrost. notes:
CONTRADICTORY GUIDANCE IN THE INTERACTION DATA: champ-data/_kits/_missing-interactions.json contains two entries for this matchup that cannot both be true. One says Camille goes untargetable through The Hextech Ultimatum and you should wait it out; the other says her R is a channel that your Permafrost or Glacial Prison 'cancels it outright'. The mirror file for camille/sejuani carries the second version too. Riot's text describes a dash that anchors the target to an area and grants untargetability — it says nothing about a channel that CC interrupts, and the 'channel' flag in the kit file looks like a tooltip-parsing artefact of the same kind the brief warns about. I wrote only the untargetability, which the description supports, and did NOT write the interrupt claim in either direction. If the interrupt is real it is the single most valuable line in this matchup and should be added by someone who can verify it; if it is not, the rule is currently seeding the same false claim into every Camille matchup in the dataset.

'W outer-blade true damage' appears seven times. Precision Protocol carries the true damage; Tactical Sweep carries the heal. The two abilities' effects were swapped throughout the entry.

spikes[2].text still reads 'passive Permafrost armor stacking'. Left as-is: correcting it inside the band would have cost the Hookshot cue in the same sentence.
